title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Deligne working record: forward cumulative through paper 016 page 30, reverse papers 090-079 complete, and complete correspondence reader lane
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing and are intentionally English-first where an English translation is present. Individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and separate correspondence items are exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. The record has three visible lanes. [########--] forward paper stream: source-checked working readers cover papers 001-013 complete, paper 014 through page 30, paper 015 complete, and paper 016 through page 30 in the sequential cumulative reader; paper 016 is not yet complete. [##########] reverse paper stream: source-checked working readers cover papers 090 down through 079 complete. [##########] correspondence lane: twelve Deligne letter/correspondence readers are present in English, each paired with a French working/source PDF. Original/reference and provenance material is preserved in ZIP artifacts and older/raw provenance versions. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Promoted the forward sequential cumulative reader from papers 001-015 to papers 001-016 through page 30, with a refreshed source-scan/TeX/QA packet. Also promoted reverse-stream Paper 079, Voevodsky's Lectures on Motivic Cohomology 2000/2001, from a pages 1-20 partial to a complete source-checked English/French reader, with a refreshed 079-090 TeX/scan/QA source ZIP. The current version is kept at Zenodo's 100-file cap by replacing superseded current-version files rather than adding duplicate provenance; displaced bulky provenance remains preserved in previous DOI versions and in the raw/provenance lane.
notes: Latest metadata update promotes the forward cumulative reader to papers 001-016 through page 30 and the reverse-stream Paper 079 reader to complete status, with refreshed source-witness TeX/scan/QA packets. Current version remains at the 100-file cap.
